parameters.query:
-- 1. Если пришел клик по кнопке — обновляем статус текущей задачи и режим сессии
WITH btn_task AS (
    UPDATE schedule
    SET 
        is_completed = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.action }}' = 'done' THEN TRUE ELSE is_completed END,
        is_reviewed_today = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.action }}' IN ('done', 'skip') THEN TRUE ELSE is_reviewed_today END
    WHERE '{{ $json.source }}' = 'button_click'
      AND id = {{ $json.task_id || 0 }}
      AND user_id = {{ $json.chat_id || 0 }}
    RETURNING title
),
btn_session AS (
    UPDATE user_session
    SET 
        current_mode = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.action }}' = 'move' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
        pending_task_id = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.action }}' = 'move' THEN {{ $json.task_id || 0 }} ELSE NULL END
    WHERE '{{ $json.source }}' = 'button_click'
      AND user_id = {{ $json.chat_id || 0 }}
),
-- 2. Ищем следующую неразобранную задачу (для конкретного юзера или для всех при Cron)
next_tasks AS (
    SELECT 
        id, user_id, title, time_start, is_important,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY time_start ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS total_left
    FROM schedule
    WHERE event_date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::DATE
      AND item_type = 'task'
      AND is_completed = FALSE
      AND is_reviewed_today = FALSE
      AND id != {{ $json.task_id || 0 }}
      AND (
          '{{ $json.source }}' = 'cron_start' 
          OR user_id = {{ $json.chat_id || 0 }}
      )
)
-- 3. Собираем финальный ответ для рендера карточки
SELECT 
    '{{ $json.source }}' AS source,
    '{{ $json.action }}' AS btn_action,
    '{{ $json.callback_query_id }}' AS callback_query_id,
    {{ $json.message_id || 'NULL' }} AS message_id,
    COALESCE(nt.user_id, {{ $json.chat_id || 'NULL' }}) AS chat_id,
    (SELECT title FROM btn_task) AS acted_title,
    nt.id AS next_id,
    nt.title AS next_title,
    nt.time_start AS next_time,
    nt.is_important AS next_important,
    nt.total_left
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN next_tasks nt ON nt.rn = 1
WHERE nt.id IS NOT NULL OR '{{ $json.source }}' != 'cron_start';
